component.name: LaserCraft
component.summary: Design and run jobs on laser cutters and engravers

description.p: LaserCraft lays out vector art, text and images on layers, plans the laser's moves and runs the job on GRBL laser controllers over USB serial, with framing, pause and stop always at hand.

ul.li: Shapes, text, SVG and DXF import, node editing and booleans
Line, fill and image layers with a job preview and time estimate
Material libraries, device profiles and test patterns
Rotary attachments, print and cut, and camera overlays
